shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper part of the surface
rectangular slab with carved/incised decoration on a flat face
justification: Both are flat slabs with decoration organised into an upper horizontal band and a larger field below, but the content is entirely different: A shows lines of alphabetic script and a single symmetrical foliate cross ornament, while B shows a row of crouching quadrupeds, a zigzag band, and animals and a large bird in profile. Beyond the generic device of banded registers on a rectangular face there is no shared motif, relationship or rendering convention — one is abstract/epigraphic, the other figural-zoomorphic.
